column1: # STRUCTURE DEBT REGISTER (this package's own) v2.0.0 -- the lines of pib-hub, and of no other package.
# The owner ruled on 2026-10-07 that a package carries its own register and clears its own lines in its own release, which is
# what BP-D54 always said; the governance aggregate carries the ceilings and the ecosystem-wide view.
# A line may be removed here, and a count lowered here, with nobody else involved: debt may always shrink. A count may NOT be
# raised here, a line the aggregate does not carry may NOT be added, and a status may NOT be raised to `exception`: the checker
# fails the run and the aggregate generator refuses it, keeping the previous ceiling. Those go through the owner's ruling,
# recorded in the aggregate line as `ruling: ...`.
# v2.0.0 (PIB v3.0.0, 2026-10-22). MAJOR, and nearly empty: ONE line left of the eighteen first measured.
#   v1.0.0 (PIB v2.19.0) 18 lines -- the first measurement of the governed home, not the nine the governance handover offered,
#     which measured the retired monorepo directory at file versions this repository had left behind.
#   v1.1.0 (PIB v2.20.0) 14 -- the four N1 lines gone: every badly-named file reissued under a conforming name and version.
#   v1.2.0 (PIB v2.21.0)  9 -- three sets of files put in the folder class that describes them (other packages' copies under
#     vendored/, the operator fixtures under fixtures/, the superseded ORCP submission under archive/). Both V1 lines and three
#     R1 lines gone, with no file edited.
#   v2.0.0 (PIB v3.0.0)   1 -- the merge: eleven files became one T-Box, one A-Box and one SHACL file, every former subject a
#     module at its own IRI, every term keeping the IRI it always had. Six R1 lines and the T and S counts are gone.
# THE ONE LINE LEFT IS NOT PIB'S TO CLOSE. The registration submission is an A-role file, and the governance owner ruled on
# 2026-10-07 that a registration is a unit of its own that obeys the three-file rule separately. Merging it into the domain
# A-Box would break that ruling; naming it as a unit needs a row in the governance session's own units table
# (OE_STRUCTURE_UNITS), which is that session's file to edit. Asked for in
# 09-handover-inbox/accepted/HANDOVER_PIB_to_OE_archive-report-and-two-asks_v1_0_0.md section 2. Until the row exists, the
# count is 2 and PIB can lower it no further without breaking a rule to satisfy a check.
# rule
U1
column4: files=2: 2 active A files; the package ships one
